intent: Make catalog search understanding visible, correctable and resilient.
observable_outcome: Visitors can inspect and correct intent without weakening catalog scope.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Five explicit intent fields use source information or null; no guessed facts.
Keywords and supported filter values drive retrieval; invalid model filters reject rewriting.
Original query survives and user corrections drive retrieval without another model rewrite.
Failed rewriting still invokes original-query vector retrieval; embedding failure is separately disclosed.

Make the explicit Chinese retrieval decision required by DISC-005-5 without deleting existing capabilities. For pg_bigm, pgroonga or pg_trgm, prove self-hosted installability and fixed-golden Chinese Top-1 at least the historical English 14/18 and above 20% (at least 24/30 Chinese tasks). Preserving current bigram alone, using Top-5, or silently removing the Chinese lexical path does not satisfy this goal. Remeasure bilingual quality and the existing poisoning redline.
Every limit is enforced and has boundary tests and applicable one-number checks.
One bounded LiteLLM rewrite call has versioned prompts, cost reporting and anonymous rate limiting.
